item.description: The Skate Cab 4 Shoe is a reissue of Steve Caballero’s fourth signature sneaker, blending heritage style with all the latest perks. Think killer boardfeel, timeless suede durability, and the legendary Caballero dragon logo. Equipped with our SickStick™ outsole for grip that sticks, PopCush™ insoles for long-lasting comfort, and a quadruple-stitched toecap to stand up to endless sessions, it’s all you need to skate your way Low-top profile inspired by '97 Cab 4 Designed for skateboarding with enhanced durability and performance features Durable suede uppers built to last Padded collar for enhanced support and comfort Lace-up closure for a secure and adjustable fit Internal tongue straps prevents it from sliding during movement Quadruple-stitched toecap to handle wear and tear PopCush™ footbeds offer impact protection and reduce leg fatigue for extended skating Cupsole construction provides enhanced support and durable SickStick™ rubber—our stickiest yet—keeps you glued to your board Signature waffle outsole pattern for reliable grip since '66 Embroidered Cab 'Dragon' logo on the quarter panel and accents on the heel and tongue Style VN000D3J689
